packagingBaselinePolicy.comparisonScope: Each candidate artifact is compared only with the identically scoped baseline artifact; the maximum scoped growth is evaluated by packaging-growth.
packagingBaselinePolicy.method: Build the planning-parent revision and candidate revision from clean checkouts with the same pinned release toolchain, target matrix, features, stripping, symbols, archive container, and uncompressed-size procedure; record each source commit, toolchain identity, artifact identity, byte count, and artifact SHA-256.
